PB09-002.name: The AntKing Ant-Res-LostSword
PB09-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] [Rebirth5]
When this Spirit attacks, or would leave the Field due to the opponent, you can flip it.

[LV2]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects, and can block while exhausted.

PB09-002-A9784.name: The FangBeastAntKingBeast Ant-Res
PB09-002-A9784.effect:
[Brave Symbol +1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
Put three cores from the Void to this Spirit. Also, if you have two counters or more, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] Flash - 2 (When Attacks)
Once per turn, heavy exhaust two opposing Spirits/Ultimates.

PB09-001.name: The GougaBeastDeity GigantGorillanga
PB09-001.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed via BP comparison, send two opposing Lives to the Reserve.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
This Spirit can't be destroyed by the opponent.

PB09-003.name: ［Memories Are Forever...］Laila Sisters
PB09-003.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Reborn)
If your Life is five or less, put a core from the Void to your Life.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When you count the number of Spirits via your Spirit effects, this Spirit is treated as two Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card from the deckbottom. If you control four or more Spirits, this effect draws +1 card.

PB09-004.name: ［Mode AGRS］Yatagarasu Magoichi
PB09-004.effect:
[+1]

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Once per turn, put two cores from the Void to this Spirit, and this Spirit can refresh. Also, if you have two counters or more, during this turn, this Spirit gains an extra Yellow symbol.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit/Nexus to the deckbottom. If you control another "Magoichi"/"Agrs"/"Kirika"-named Spirit, negate the effects of that Spirit/Nexus.

PB09-004-A15072.name: ［Pearly Purple Ballista］Yatagarasu Magoichi
PB09-004-A15072.effect:
This card/Nexus's reduction symbols are also treated as Red/Purple/Green/White/Blue, and its (When Deployed) effect is unaffected by opposing effects.

[LV1] [Rebirth5]
When your "Magoichi"/"Agrs"/"Kirika"-named Spirit attacks, or when this Nexus would leave the Field due to an opposing effect, you can flip this Nexus, putting your [Soul Core] onto it.

[LV1] (When Deployed)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Among them, you can summon/deploy a "Magoichi"/"Agrs"/"Kirika"-named card without paying the cost. Return any remaining card(s) to the deckbottom. However, any (When Summoned/Deployed) effects of the Spirit/Nexus can't activate.

[LV1] (Your Main Step)
By paying two costs, activate this Nexus's (When Deployed) effect. This effect can only be used once per turn.

PB09-003-A15310.name: ［The Brilliance of One Summer］Laila Sisters
PB09-003-A15310.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] [Rebirth5]
During either Attack Step, when your Life is reduced, or any Spirit is summoned via your effects, this Spirit can be flipped.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When you count the number of Spirits via your Spirit effects, this Spirit is treated as two Spirits.

[LV2][LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.
